objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: A type-based abbreviation prefix combined with a consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid indicating the strategic or operational scope of the document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The current version number of the document, incremented upon each new editing/release cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the document version is considered valid, set upon release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The configurable time span (default 3 years) after which the document must be reviewed for continued validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The configurable retention period (default 10 years) for archived documents before physical deletion.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope or area of validity of the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational entities for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Specific areas or domains where the document applies.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications associated with or referenced by the document.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language in which the document content is maintained or translated.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: The person registered as the primary author responsible for creating the document.

attributes.name: co_authors
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned personal change rights on the document alongside the primary author.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document content for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for final approval and release of the document to readers.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the released document.

attributes.name: releaser_translation
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check and release translated versions of the document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute controlling email notification distribution when a new version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute controlling acknowledgement-based distribution requiring active confirmation from recipients.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the release of the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object linked to a document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle and can be published directly.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changes to an existing released document, created by any user with author rights without affecting the document's current content or version history.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation, triggering an archiving process that revokes all authorizations except for the archive group.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated (archived) document and its attachments, restoring original metadata and authorizations.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used to assign read, change, or role-based authorizations and distribution lists for documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person in the system who can be assigned roles and authorizations for document management activities.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process flow controlling the steps of document creation, review, release, validity extension, override, reactivation, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by workflow participants to formally confirm completion of their workflow task, documented per released version.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and individual persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement-based distribution upon release.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity within the company that can be linked to documents and processes.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents and used for process-specific filing of policies and guidelines.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents via master data references.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: An IT application master data object that can be referenced by and linked to documents.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user- and role-specific view providing document lists, evaluation reports, and status information to users based on their distribution group assignments.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational client in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or hidden, but not modified.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A workflow-supported confirmation by a recipient on the distribution list that they have read and noted a released document version.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A user creates a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object, selecting a document type and optionally a template, and maintaining its metadata and properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The author or co-author edits the content of a document using the integrated editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The author or co-author modifies metadata or attributes of a document via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts the saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The author or a co-author initiates the 3-step release workflow (Creator - Review - Release) for a document.

evts.name: sign_as_creator
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first step of the release workflow using an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and formal correctness and completes the review task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, completing the task with an electronic signature, making the document visible to readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: create_new_editing_version
evts.description: The system automatically creates a new editing version of a released document when revisions are initiated, retaining all data from the previous version.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: The author adds a controlled attachment sub-document to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: The author modifies an existing attachment linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next version of the main document, revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: The author adds a supplementary additional information object to a document, which is published directly without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: The author deletes an additional information object from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A user with author rights creates a change proposal for an existing released document without affecting its content or version history.

evts.name: process_change_proposal
evts.description: The author of the underlying document documents the editing of assigned change proposals, notifying the creator upon completion.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document in which the change proposal note can be printed.

evts.name: generate_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before a document's valid-until date expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (or author, reviewer, and releaser) confirms extended validity of a document via the validity extension workflow, updating the valid-until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: The system automatically starts the override workflow after a request for override is created.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: The releaser (or initiator, reviewer, and releaser) approves the override request, setting the document status to out of force and revoking all rights except archive group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: A document and its attachments are archived by revoking all authorizations except for the archive group, starting the archive duration countdown.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: The system physically deletes a document after its archive duration has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A user in the Business Admin group creates a request for reactivation, selecting an invalidated document for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation in the workflow, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata, authorizations, distribution lists, and reactivated attachments.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to users and user groups on the distribution list when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_document_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: The system sends email requests to users and user groups on the distribution list to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document version.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient on the distribution list confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates the content of a released document into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The releaser for translation checks and releases a translated version of a document via a workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Group and person-related read and change authorizations are assigned to a document via user group and person attributes in the document properties.

evts.name: set_document_visibility_in_client
evts.description: A user specifies in which clients of a multi-client system a document is visible or hidden.

o2o.description: A document can have one or more controlled attachments linked to it that are released together with the main document.
A document can have one or more supplementary additional information objects linked to it.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within that document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity must be checked.
A request for override is created for a specific document to initiate its invalidation.
A request for reactivation references the invalidated document to be reactivated.
Documents can reference other documents via the references attribute or as local extensions in a multi-client setup.
Documents can be linked to business processes for process-specific filing.
Documents can be linked to organizational units within the company.
Documents can be linked to risk objects via master data references.
Documents can be linked to IT application master data objects.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new documents.
Each document has a distribution list defining user groups and persons for email notification or acknowledgement distribution.
A distribution list contains user groups whose members receive distribution notifications or acknowledgement requests.
A distribution list can contain individual persons directly assigned for distribution.
Users are assigned to user groups which grant them roles, authorizations, and access to documents.
A document can be made visible or hidden in specific clients of a multi-client system.
Electronic signatures of workflow participants are documented per released version of a document.
